gallery.title: File:Cash relief helps urban poor cope with rising prices (7534887462).jpg
gallery.credit: Cash relief helps urban poor cope with rising prices
gallery.source: Cash relief helps urban poor cope with rising prices (7534887462)
gallery.description:
Many urban communities in South Sudan are struggling to cope with an influx of people, lack of services, and high food prices. Oxfam’s food security projects provide cash payments to the poorest families in the town of Malakal, providing a vital lifeline to help them buy staple foods. Recipients of the cash also take part in community clean-up campaigns, gathering and burning waste that can otherwise create a health risk. 
Photo: Dauda Koroma/Oxfam

Find out more at oxf.am/JxM

The lyre, played throughout Sudan, migrated from the Middle East through Saharan
Africa and into Sub-Saharan Africa.



Northern kisir ? lyres are often played for
dance, while those in the south, such as
the tom lyre, accompany bardic poetry
and praise songs.

The largest country in Africa, Sudan is
divided north and south by the Sahara
Desert and east and west by the Nile River.
Tha Islamic Arabs of the north use drums
such as the nobo to acompany religious


music. Apart from the lyre, the eastern
Sudanese Arabs play one stringed ...kiki ?
fidle, the kurbi ? harp, and a variety of drums.
Groups in southern Sudan are known for
ensembles of one-pitched wind instruments
such as the now rare Bongo mand?nd?i ? and
Dinka side-blown trumpets on display.

We read about the Musical Instrument Museum (MIM) on Trip Advisor - it was the top rated attraction in Phoenix - and now we can see why! The museum is dedicated to musical instruments from around the world - the collection is fascinating, the exhibits are great and the hands-on displays were fun. We spent almost 5 hours here and still felt rushed - this place is definitely worth a detour.
I know nothing about musical instruments so if you happen to know what a particular instrument is, please feel free to comment on it. I tried to include as many labels as possible.
The museum is in Phoenix, AZ - we visited it in March 2014.

gallery.title: File:Hygiene campaigns (7361071806).jpg
gallery.description:
Six hygiene campaigns have been carried out in three different areas of Malakal. The campaigns involved collecting and burning waste that has gathered around the community.

Photo: Dauda Koroma / Oxfam

gallery.title: File:A community in Malakal (7361075686).jpg
gallery.description:
The high inflation and rising food prices have hit the poorest families the hardest.
The Oxfam cash project aims to improve food security, livelihoods and health for 2,000 families - about 14,000 people - in three parts of the town.

Photo: Dauda Koroma / Oxfam

gallery.title: File:Cashing the cheques (7361081176).jpg
gallery.description:
People are then taken to a local bank where they can cash the cheques. For many of the people involved it was their first time inside a bank.

Photo: Dauda Koroma / Oxfam

gallery.title: File:Eligible people receive cheques (7361085488).jpg
gallery.description:
Once their identities have been verified, each eligible person receives a cheque. 
A total of $450 is paid out in three equal installments. Each month, each family receives a cheque for 398 South Sudanese Pounds (about $150). 

Photo: Dauda Koroma / Oxfam
